title: type-alias-impl-trait with lifetime param can't be used in fn input
body:
I tried this code: https://play.rust-lang.org/?version=nightly&mode=debug&edition=2021&gist=f758d0536248cf9a970114bf75257429 ```rust #![feature(type_alias_impl_trait)] type Ty<'a> = impl FnOnce() -> &'a str; fn defining(s: &str) -> Ty<'_> { move || s } fn execute(ty: Ty<'_>) -> &str { ty() } ``` I expected to see this happen: *program compiles* Instead, this happened: ```rust error[E0581]: return type references an anonymous lifetime, which is not constrained by the fn input types --> src/lib.rs:4:27 | 4 | fn execute(ty: Ty<'_>) -> &str { ty() } | ^^^^ | = note: lifetimes appearing in an associated type are not considered constrained ``` Same code compiles if type params are used instead: ```rust #![feature(type_alias_impl_trait)] type Ty = impl FnOnce() -> T; fn defining(s: T) -> Ty { move || s } fn execute(ty: Ty) -> T { ty() } ``` ### Meta Nightly playground : 1.62.0-nightly (2022-04-28 e85edd9a844b523a02db)
